index-columns.label: self_consistent_hubbard_U_eV
index-columns.name: [2D altermagnetism] Self-consistent Hubbard U
index-columns.description: Self-consistent Hubbard U for transition-metal d orbitals, obtained using density-functional perturbation theory.

index-columns.label: maximum_splitting_meV
index-columns.name: [2D altermagnetism] Maximum spin splitting
index-columns.description: Maximum spin splitting across the full 2D Brillouin zone over all calculated electronic states, regardless of occupation.

index-columns.label: maximum_splitting_near_E_F_meV
index-columns.name: [2D altermagnetism] Maximum spin splitting near EF
index-columns.description: Maximum spin splitting associated with the highest occupied states in insulators or partially occupied states in metals. The insulating energy reference is the valence-band maximum.

index-columns.label: band_gap_eV
index-columns.name: [2D altermagnetism] Band gap
index-columns.description: Electronic band gap from the refined DFT+U calculation at the reported self-consistent Hubbard U.

index-columns.label: delta_E_min_AM_NAM_meV_per_magnetic_atom
index-columns.name: [2D altermagnetism] Magnetic energy difference
index-columns.description: Energy difference (E_NAM,min - E_AM)/N_mag at the unrelaxed structure, in meV per magnetic atom. Positive values favor AM; negative values favor the lowest-energy competing non-altermagnetic collinear magnetic state.
